Guides

The rent-vs-buy decision, explained with real numbers from a documented model — not rules of thumb.

  • Is Buying Always Better Than Renting? No — Here’s When Renting Wins

    Renting isn't throwing money away: our model shows ~$2,400 of an owner's $3,067 monthly cost is just as unrecoverable as rent. See when renting wins.

  • Is It Better to Rent or Buy in 2026? The Actual Math

    At 2026's ~6.5% rates, our model shows renting beats buying by ~$67,000 over 10 years on a typical home. The 3 numbers that decide it, and when buying wins.

    Rent vs buy as of July 2026: 30-year rates near 6.5-7% keep renting ahead in most US markets. See the exact rent, by rate, at which buying starts to win.

  • When Does Buying Beat Renting? Finding Your Break-Even Year

    Break-even is a net-worth crossover, not monthly-cost parity. Our model: no break-even within 30 years at 6.5%, but year 6 at 4%. Find your break-even year.
